posts.text:
Google has reportedly been testing Gemini 4 Carbon on Arena under Argon 4 since October 31st. 

It seems to be one of the best models among those announced to date. 

Stunning outputs
posts.quoted: Carbon-H is being tested on Arena AI as Argon 4. It's much better than earlier Carbon builds at coding, design and 3D, and feels faster too. Some outputs look strangely similar to Opus 5.5. Google finally seems to be taking things seriously and improving its models.
